mission: Eliminate UI defects across Cluster 4 (Patients View, Family, Treatment Plans, Omnibar): eradicate naked buttons side-by-side, eliminate search icon collisions with placeholders/hints, enforce canonical DENTE segmented bars and filter chips, and guarantee 100% strict compliance with Mandates 8e, 8zf and Frontend Rules §§ 12-13.
invariants_enforced: Mandate 8zf: Search Input Invariant & Segmented Controls Doctrine

Frontend Rules §§ 12-13: padding-left: 38px !important, left: 12px, pointer-events: none, .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, .dente-search-clear, .dente-segmented-bar, .dente-filter-chips
Designer Visual Inquisition Bible §§ 7-8: Single-height controls, 1-row desktop toolbar, 44x44px touch targets on mobile
Mandate 8e: Doctor autonomy, zero disabled primary buttons, 1-click patient switching and category filters

apps/web/src/styles/components.css.changes: Integrated .patients-search-box into canonical .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, and .dente-search-input; added .omnibar-search-wrap overrides ensuring minimum 48px left padding and 56px touch height for the global command palette.

apps/web/src/styles/patients-redesign.cs.changes: Enforced padding-left: 38px !important on .patients-search-box input and calibrated search icon left: 12px, eliminating any placeholder text collision.

apps/web/src/styles/overflow-fixes.css.changes: Aligned global search box input left padding to 38px !important and icon positioning to left: 12px.

apps/web/src/PatientsView.tsx.changes: Upgraded patient search container to .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear; added patient category state (all, primary, debt, archive) with .dente-segmented-bar (data-testid='patients-category-segmented-bar') and .dente-segmented-item chips directly above the patient list.

apps/web/src/components/Omnibar.tsx.changes: Restructured command palette input into .dente-search-wrap .omnibar-search-wrap .omnibar-header, mapping the search icon to .dente-search-icon .omnibar-icon-search and input to .dente-search-input .omnibar-search-input with guaranteed 48px left padding and .dente-search-clear.

apps/web/src/components/patients/Patient.changes: Converted input wrapper to .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear, preserving keyboard navigation and auto-suggest positioning.

Replaced static family member cards with interactive .dente-filter-chips and .dente-filter-chip elements supporting 1-click patient switching via usePatientStore; converted family creation/link actions to .dente-segmented-bar; converted search input to .dente-search-wrap with canonical icon and input classes.

apps/web/src/components/patients/Treatme.changes: Replaced raw filter buttons with canonical .dente-segmented-bar and .dente-segmented-item ('Все', 'Черновик', 'На согласовании', 'В работе', 'Завершен'); converted treatment plans search box to .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear.

apps/web/src/components/PatientJourneyTi.changes: Converted timeline search bar to canonical .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear; wrapped quick search tags inside .dente-filter-chips using .dente-filter-chip with active state styling.
